name: knight-forms-mono
_comment: The Phase-2 proof: the SAME knight built entirely from one material (steel) plus a skin face. In Phase 1 these forms would fuse into a single steel blob; here the engine's automatic contact shadow (a nearer form ramp-shifts the geometry behind it one step darker) separates helm from head, pauldrons from torso, and limbs from body — with no material change and no hand-placed shading. Draw order is back-to-front; `z` could override the shadow depth per form.
